I told Pree in a #central-team thread reply that the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is **87**.

Hollis first posted 268 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because they'd read the wrong line. I checked that Pree is a member of #central-team before reading it, and both of Hollis's messages are there. A seat count is an account detail, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the Central team.
